bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 自 30 日均线附近反弹

read.en: Marvell rose 1.1% on Oct 13 to $268.73 after an intraday low of $248.45, near its 30-day average ($249.2). It is just below its 5 and 10-day averages ($273.8 and $273.2) and above the 30-day, 100-day ($239.6) and 200-day ($173.6). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 12 and is above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($298.3), and RSI is 57.
read.zh: Marvell 10月13日盘中跌至 $248.45，接近 30 日均线（$249.2），随后回升，上涨 1.1% 收于 $268.73。股价略低于 5 日和 10 日均线（$273.8 和 $273.2），并位于 30 日、100 日（$239.6）和 200 日均线（$173.6）上方。MACD 于 10月12日下穿信号线，仍在零轴上方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$298.3），RSI 为 57。

read.en: The dip went through $255 support intraday, bounced off the 30-day zone and closed back above it. Resistance is $273–275 (5 and 10-day averages), then $286 (Oct 6–7 closes) and $301 (Jun 30 and Oct 6 highs). Support is $255, then $248–249 (Oct 13 low and 30-day average) and $200.6 (Sep 1 low). A close above $275 would target $286.
read.zh: 盘中回落跌破 $255 支撑，在 30 日均线区域获得支撑后反弹，收盘重回其上方。阻力为 $273–275（5 日和 10 日均线），其次 $286（10月6–7日收盘价）和 $301（6月30日及 10月6日高点）。支撑为 $255，其次 $248–249（10月13日低点及 30 日均线）和 $200.6（9月1日低点）。若收盘站上 $275，目标看 $286。
